api_doc_gaps.detail: SVC-API declared the NOTIF constants with SINGULAR nouns (PERM_NOTIF_TEMPLATE_*, PERM_NOTIF_CHANNEL_*) while the page_codes are PLURAL (NOTIF_TEMPLATES/NOTIF_CHANNELS); runtime-generated + V7-seeded codes are PLURAL (PERM_<PAGE_CODE>_<TYPE>), so every template/channel endpoint would have 403'd.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: RESOLVED. Renamed the 8 constants and their string VALUES to the PLURAL page-code-derived form (PERM_NOTIF_TEMPLATES_*, PERM_NOTIF_CHANNELS_*) and updated all @PreAuthorize refs in NotificationTemplateService/NotificationChannelConfigService; V7 seeds PERMISSION_CODE identical to these constants. PERM_NOTIF_LOG_VIEW already matched. Compile passes; grep for old singular names returns nothing.

api_doc_gaps.detail: SVC-API gated dispatch with @PreAuthorize hasAuthority(PERM_NOTIF_DISPATCH), but dispatch (API-NOTIF-001, RULE-NOTIF-005) is behind the Security filter with no management screen and SEC_PERMISSION.PAGE_FK is NOT NULL — so no PERM_NOTIF_DISPATCH row can be seeded, meaning the gate would always deny.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: RESOLVED. Re-gated dispatch to @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()") (any authenticated principal, matching 'behind the Security filter'); removed the unused PERM_NOTIF_DISPATCH constant and dropped its crossmodule javadoc references; no dispatch permission is seeded in V7. Programmatic/event-driven dispatch with no principal (internal trusted-caller pattern) is a future concern — the XM/event triggers are DEFERRED, so no principal-less caller exists yet.

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: POST /api/v1/notifications/templates and PUT /api/v1/notifications/templates/{id} (API-NOTIF-004) — ERR-0001 NOTIF_TEMPLATE_BILINGUAL_REQUIRED (RULE-NOTIF-004 / TC-BE-NOTIF-006)
api_doc_gaps.detail: The module's artifacts publish ERR-0001 NOTIF_TEMPLATE_BILINGUAL_REQUIRED, but the code is structurally unreachable over HTTP on BOTH create and update. TemplateCreateRequest and TemplateUpdateRequest each carry @NotBlank on bodyAr and bodyEn, so Spring bean validation refuses at the controller boundary and GlobalExceptionHandler.handleValidation answers 400 / VALIDATION_ERROR with a fieldErrors entry naming the missing body, before NotificationTemplateService's domain re-validation — the throw site of ERR-0001 — is entered. Verified against the running app 2026-09-12: create without bodyEn returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming bodyEn; update dropping bodyAr returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming bodyAr. The rule IS enforced; only the published code is unobservable. TC-BE-NOTIF-006 was corrected on both halves to assert the real contract (400, VALIDATION_ERROR, fieldErrors naming bodyEn / bodyAr).
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — human decision required: either (a) relax the @NotBlank bean validation on the template body fields so the domain rule owns the refusal and ERR-0001 becomes reachable (losing handleValidation's per-field detail and its report-all-failures-at-once behaviour), or (b) strike ERR-0001 from NOTIF's error catalog and state in the artifacts that RULE-NOTIF-004 is enforced structurally at the DTO layer. No error-catalog file was edited by this entry.

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: API REGISTRY in P3_1/backend-execution-plan.md — written as prose, so no served NOTIF endpoint can be stamped with its API-NOTIF id
api_doc_gaps.detail: Found 2026-09-23 by the api-doc generator's new `check` mode (contract-ids: 0/14 endpoints stamped; the plan has an API REGISTRY heading but no row the extractor can read). The registry lists several entries per line with `CRUD` in place of a verb, so it carries no unambiguous verb+path pair; SEC, MDL and FIN plans write it as a table and stamp fully. Consequence: NOTIF's published api-docs carry no Contract ID line and no drift table, so a frontend or test author resolving API-NOTIF-nnn has to open the plan and read a proposed path rather than a served one. The generator will not guess an id from prose. Remedy is the factory's: rewrite the registry as a table with one row per endpoint (id | operation | verb | path). Nothing in this repo was changed for this entry.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — factory owns the plan; `check` fails contract-ids for NOTIF until the table exists
